excerpts.text: - [x] AsyncLocalStorage: optional `EmittedAsyncLocalStorageRuntime` owns its constructor declaration; four helpers receive explicit component and function dependencies. Merged in #1666 after all CI gates and review passed; all 571 regression cases covered, including 29 new cases. Eleven IL-verified probes preserve normalized metadata and all 12,241 method bodies/exception regions, with nine exact standalone executions and two hosted assemblies. The primitive-import review finding was reproduced as an existing resolver rejection before code generation.

- [x] Boolean: required checked owner holds truthiness, prototype field and population declarations. Merged in #1684 after all main/desktop gates and the 44-file implementation review plus review covering the final CI correction passed with no actionable findings. Five scoped emitter boundaries use explicit object, descriptor and error inputs, preserving early RegExp truthiness references and later prototype bodies. All 1,258 local regression cases and 37 new cases passed (18 owner/staging/selection/hosting/native/reuse, 19 isolated CLI outputs). All 21 IL-verified saved comparisons preserve normalized metadata and 21,846 method bodies/exception regions, with 19 exact executions and two hosted outputs. Immutable-head source audit, Release builds and code-quality checks passed; final comment-only corrections retain explicit verification provenance. Final CI passed 21,649 core tests plus 1 existing platform skip on Linux and 21,647 core tests plus 3 existing platform skips on Windows, with 129 GUI passes per platform and zero failures. All 37 new cases and unchanged generator, fork IPC and lifecycle controls passed on both platforms. Guest prototype mutability, identity, branding, descriptors and BCL BigInteger truthiness are unchanged. Existing CommonJS constructor-alias behavior is preserved, not fixed. The overall CI build job now allows 40 minutes after the previous 30-minute cap interrupted a passing Windows core run during GUI checks; core/GUI step limits, individual deadlines, assertions and performance budgets remain unchanged. The separate JSON reuse defect and all broader ownership/audit work remain required.

- [x] General numeric coercion: required `EmittedNumericCoercionRuntime` owns five conversion declarations with checked access, repairable initialization and validated completion. Merged in #1685 after all CI/Desktop gates and exact-head 55-file review passed with no actionable findings. Five emitter boundaries take the owner and exact immutable conversion, descriptor, invocation and error inputs. All 179 bound references migrate, including conditional reads, while early RegExp declarations, the required BigInt adapter, native signatures/inlining and per-assembly indirect function lookup remain unchanged. All 2,623 broader regression cases and 38 new cases passed (20 owner/staging/selection/hosting/native/cache/reuse, 18 isolated outputs). Twenty saved assemblies pass IL verification and preserve normalized metadata, imports, constants and 20,679 method bodies/exception regions, with 18 exact executions and two hosted outputs. Source audit preserves six complete bodies, surrounding scoped files, full orchestration and 46 other consumer files after equivalent substitutions; Release and code-quality checks pass. Final CI passed 21,687 core tests plus 1 existing platform skip on Linux and 21,685 core tests plus 3 existing platform skips on Windows, plus 129 GUI tests per platform and zero failures. All 38 new cases and unchanged generator, fork IPC and lifecycle controls passed on both platforms. Existing explicit Number exotic-hook and CommonJS alias behavior remains preserved. No CI limits, test assertions or performance budgets changed in this phase; JSON reuse and the complete remaining ownership/audit scope remain required.
